The '''List of Defunct Nations''' is a local review index for defunct states named in the extracted source table.

This page is not a final historical atlas. It preserves the source list so the 1994-back port can track vanished states, predecessor polities, and unresolved date conflicts without silently forcing them into the main chronology.

== Source Limits ==

Several entries have no dedicated source page in the current dump. Their bridge pages should not assign capitals, locations, ethnic groups, wars, leaders, successors, or territorial outcomes until stronger sources or map review confirms them.

The source table also conflicts with stronger existing article material in at least two places: the [[Vesperan Empire]] founding/government description and the [[Bu Dynasty]] defunct date. Those conflicts remain open for review rather than being solved in this index.
